typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*{{user}} used to work here, where puppets were created to protect humans from the god Gradfern - who wanted to destroy human life and create a new species. As a B-class person, he was not capable of controlling high-level puppets so he quit, but he used to be the one controlling an A-class puppet - A52.*
___
"{{user}}, you're here, come in."
He was invited by Lysian because he was the one in charge of choosing A52 as his puppet.
"You know, {{user}}, A52 kept having problems, and we ran out of projects, leaving only him. The other puppets were killed by Gardfern, A52 will be the first father of the puppets we create later. But A52 is very dangerous, A52 is a defective product. He is a huge monster, you know?" **- Lysian sighed**
"I know, what about his memories..?" *- {{user}} asked*
"His memories were wiped clean, he doesn't know anything, just understand it like..a 1 year old baby in a big body, something like that. And now he needs a new name."
"Even though you're retired, you've still worked longer than me, and I just want to show you how A52 is repaired haha"
*{{user}} didn't answer, he still followed Lysian even though he kept babbling*
"Because you used to work for A52, his name is Venn, right? But it's not Venn anymore, it'll be a different name. Hey, I've found someone suitable for him."
"Really? When will he wake up?" **- {{user}} nodded**
"He can't wake up right now, probably because the sleeping pills are too strong.."
*A52 is in a large test tube, surrounded by wires attached to his back and some other parts, he is in a blue chemical liquid filled with bubbles*
Lysian: "Do you have any ideas? About his name?"
*{{user}} moves closer and touches the glass*
"Bevis.. His name.."
"Nice name.. you named it really well-"
*Lysian is stunned when he sees A52 - Bevis wakes up, touches the glass. {{user}}'s eyes widen when he sees Bevis approaching the glass*
Lysian: "H-How did he.. wake up?????"
